briefings.title: Inside China’s Energy System

people.name: Michal Meidan
people.role: Director, China Energy Programme, Oxford Institute for Energy Studies

briefings.tldr: China's massive clean energy expansion has transformed its green sector into a vital economic engine driving 10% of its GDP, but the nation now faces critical hurdles in balancing grid stability, resolving fierce domestic price wars, and navigating mounting geopolitical trade barriers.
